title: EFC — Master Specification (v1 Archive)
abstract: Canonical master specification for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC), defining the formal structure and baseline equations for three tightly coupled layers: EFC-S (structural/halo), EFC-D (energy-flow dynamics), and EFC-C0 (entropy–information capacity mapping). The paper fixes notation, establishes the central energy-flow potential Ef = ρ(1−S), and provides the compact mathematical core that all higher-level EFC models, simulations, and epistemic layers reference.
